name: boss-11
about: Boss Rush: Patrimony Phantom (half bone, half steel, with a cleaver). Tripo H3.1 from concept boss11-phantom-sd-1; rigged by Tripo (rig v1.0, biped); eight clips retargeted from Tripo's presets (two requests); parts from Tripo segmentation, each bound whole to the bone that owns it, so the armour stays rigid on a motion-captured skeleton.
